points.statement: The aim is an efficient and effective model for medical image restoration.
points.quote: We aim to build an efficient and effective model for medical image restoration based on the Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) peng2023rwkv, termed Restore-RWKV.

points.statement: An attention mechanism effectively builds global dependencies with linear computational complexity.
points.quote: First, in Section 3.3, we introduce a recurrent WKV (Re-WKV) attention mechanism that effectively builds global dependencies in 2D images with linear computational complexity.

points.statement: A shift mechanism accurately captures local context to enhance model performance.
points.quote: Second, in Section 3.4, we introduce an omnidirectional token shift mechanism that accurately captures local context to enhance the model performance.

points.statement: Bidirectional attention is basic for a global receptive field, and recurrent attention effectively models dependencies from various scan directions.
points.quote: Re-WKV incorporates bidirectional attention as basic for a global receptive field and recurrent attention to effectively model 2D dependencies from various scan directions.

points.statement: A token shift layer enhances local dependencies by shifting tokens from all directions and across a wide context range.
points.quote: Second, we develop an omnidirectional token shift (Omni-Shift) layer that enhances local dependencies by shifting tokens from all directions and across a wide context range.

points.statement: A larger receptive field lets the model capture information from a wider region and reference more pixels to improve recovery of degraded areas.
points.quote: On one hand, a larger receptive field enables the model to capture information from a wider region, allowing it to reference more pixels to improve the recovery of the degraded areas.

points.statement: A larger receptive field allows capturing high-level patterns and structures that are essential for effective medical image restoration.
points.quote: On the other hand, a larger receptive field allows the model to capture high-level patterns and structures, which are essential for effective medical image restoration guo2025mambair.
